candidate_repairs.threshold_check: Ordinary overtrigger recurs in three distinct source identities: a simulation best-practice guide, a conformational-ensemble review, and a maximum-entropy methods paper.

exact_source_evidence.finding: The source is a general guide for reporting sampling uncertainty and explicitly excludes systematic model error; it is not a source-specific measurement record.
The source is a conceptual review of integrating experiments, models, and observable-calculation methods.
The same review exposes a forward-mapping obligation rather than a single empirical sample or native measurement record.
The source derives maximum-entropy restraint behavior and its ensemble-average limitations; it is not one empirical source object with a sample-system declaration.

affected_canonical_surface.current_predicate: Both bindings apply to a SOURCE target with an existing source.source_id, without an evidence-object-kind or source-purpose guard.

candidate_repairs.current_behavior: The two complete-draft declaration Rules produce unresolved source-context and native-measurement obligations for method reviews and general guides that do not make one empirical source-object claim. This creates eight unnecessary Rule-instance obligations across four challenge units.
candidate_repairs.proposed_behavior: In a future proposal, narrow SOURCE applicability so F02R01 and F03R01 apply only to an admitted empirical or claim-evidence source object with a declared measurement/source purpose. A review, guide, or methods article without such an object should be classified for human review rather than forced through sample-composition and native-measurement declaration checks.
candidate_repairs.generic_rationale: The trigger is the current structural predicate, not a scientific peculiarity of one paper. The same pattern appears in three independent literature types and recurs when the Thomasen review is challenged from two different source-first questions.
candidate_repairs.likely_overtrigger_risk: A too-narrow predicate could suppress necessary declaration review for a real empirical record that is incorrectly classified as a review or methods source.
candidate_repairs.effect_on_claim_ceiling: No local PASS may be broadened. The narrowing only prevents irrelevant unresolved obligations; empirical source declarations retain their existing source-local ceiling and human gate.
candidate_repairs.rejection_condition: Reject the repair if a source-type/purpose guard cannot be populated before applicability without circular inference, or if review/method sources demonstrably need F02/F03 declaration checks for an admitted empirical evidence object.

deferred_non_repair_findings.finding: Choosing publication-level versus modality-level source-object granularity is a source-science design decision. The current F03 contract can evaluate a chosen object but does not decide the decomposition.
deferred_non_repair_findings.reason_not_proposed: One high-information integrative paper reveals the question, but its appropriate answer depends on source semantics and must not be automated into a generic canonical split without human review.

deferred_non_repair_findings.finding: F03R01 has no explicit source-local F02R01 prerequisite even when construct/condition context is required before measurement interpretation.
deferred_non_repair_findings.reason_not_proposed: The challenge exposes one direct dependency instance. The ordinary-gap threshold for a generic repair is not met by two independent source papers in this corpus.

deferred_non_repair_findings.finding: Maximum-entropy bias and nonunique distributions require method-specific interpretation beyond the current candidate identifiability map.
deferred_non_repair_findings.reason_not_proposed: One methods paper does not justify a generic Rule family or runtime change.
